ndc0d250a47.headline: The economy fell 7.5% in November, the worst figure since 2009
ndc0d250a47.summary: Argentina's economy contracted 7.5% in November, marking the worst monthly decline since 2009, following a 2% drop in the previous year.
ndc0d250a47.why: Argentina's economic performance is closely watched due to its history of volatility and impact on regional markets and investor confidence in Latin America.
ndc0d250a47.why_moved: The sharp economic contraction signals deteriorating fundamentals, likely impacting investor sentiment and regional economic outlook.

n19366e668a.headline: Why this economist is forecasting a 15% plunge in the Aussie dollar to US60 cents
n19366e668a.summary: An economist forecasts a 15% plunge in the Australian dollar to US60 cents, which could influence currency markets and related assets.
n19366e668a.why: The Australian dollar is a major currency impacting regional and global markets; a sharp decline affects exporters, importers, and currency traders.
n19366e668a.why_moved: The forecast suggests a significant depreciation of the Australian dollar, likely impacting currency and equity markets.
